title: Session prep
summary: The first evening's running order, from the mill at dusk to the foot of the chapel stair.

sessions.title: Session 1 - The Miller at Dusk
sessions.summary: [[wenna-brask|Wenna]] asks for help as the sun goes down and the bell does not ring. The party goes up to the chapel, meets [[brother-aldous|Brother Aldous]], and goes down the stair to the landing ([[L1 area 1]]). A short evening: it ends at the carved doors or at the goblins' den, whichever the party picks.

canon.heading: The bell has been silent for ten days
canon.body: Nobody in Millbrook knows why. Brother Aldous tells anyone who asks that the bell-rope has rotted.

canon.heading: Tam went down three days ago
canon.body: At dusk, with one of the mill's lanterns. Nobody has seen him since.

scenes.title: The mill at dusk
scenes.purpose: [[wenna-brask|Wenna]] gives the quest, and the silence at dusk sets the mood.

beats.heading: No bell
beats.body: Dusk comes and the bell doesn't ring. Wenna stops in the middle of a sentence to listen for it.

beats.heading: The ask
beats.body: She offers her 15 gp and describes Tam's boots, split heel and all.

scenes.title: Millbrook chapel
scenes.purpose: Meet [[brother-aldous|Aldous]], and let him tell his lie.

beats.heading: Aldous at the door
beats.body: He says the undercroft is locked and the bell-rope has rotted. Neither is true.

beats.heading: Dust on his sandals
beats.body: Anyone who looks down sees grey undercroft dust on his sandals.

scenes.title: Undercroft Landing
scenes.when: Late, as long as it takes
scenes.purpose: The first choice below: the goblins' den to the west, or the carved doors to the south.

beats.heading: Tracks
beats.body: Let them read the tracks and find Tam's broken lantern before they choose.

decisions.heading: Does Aldous follow them down?
decisions.body: If he sees the party go below, Aldous may slip down after them to warn Grask. Decide before the session whether he tries, and whether the warden lets him pass.
